pick_mode: Predicted homogeneous 6.0/3.5 km/s travel times; not observed picks
selection_rule: Three closest 3D published catalogue pairs, 12:00–13:00 UTC, origin separation >30 s; no waveform selection
processing: Unchanged 2–14 Hz, 50 Hz sample rate, 0.5 s max lag, minCC 0.70, minSNR 1.5 public settings
notes: A software/data exercise; not independent proof that phase predictions or differential times are scientifically correct.
